description: TypeScript adds type checks to JavaScript. A type says what kind of value a name should hold, such as a number or some text. Think of labels on school boxes: pencils go here, books go there. TypeScript can spot some mix-ups before you run your code. Learn JavaScript first, then try the small TypeScript examples. They show code and answers; this site does not run TypeScript.
versionNote: Targets TypeScript 5.9 with strict mode on and Node.js 24 LTS tooling (npm, npx tsc, tsx). Where TypeScript 6 or Node's built-in type stripping behaves differently, the lesson says so.
whatYouWillLearn: Label values as numbers, text or true-or-false choices
Read and fix a simple type error
Describe lists, objects and functions with types
Understand which checks happen before a program runs
